 Every WWE World Champion When EVERY GTA Game Was Released
 8. Steve Austin (GTA III)
 WWE/Rockstar Games 
 Oh hell yeah.
 OK, so Steve Austin wasn't quite the rebellious antihero he'd been throughout most of the 'Attitude Era' by 2001, but he was still one of the biggest stars in the industry. Rockstar Games became one of the biggest in their field too by casually dropping a total game-changer onto the new fangled PS2 console on 23 October 2001.
 Culturally, the world was still in flux following the 9/11 terror attacks in New York. That made GTA III's launch a bit more challenging, but then...people were looking for something entertaining to distract them from the grim horrors of reality. GTA III scratched an itch that's somehow kept people playing for approx 25 years now.
 It changed from a top down look to a fully 3D landscape that seemed to reinvent the wheel for open world action adventure titles. In truth, there were parallels between GTA's formula and the WWF's. They both courted controversy and refused to shy away from controversial topics to get attention.
 All press is good press etc etc.
 On TV, 'Stone Cold' won the WWF Title from temporary babyface Kurt Angle  on the 8 October Raw. He'd hold that for a short spell before losing it to Chris Jericho at Vengeance on 9 December. Of course, 'Y2J' went on to become the first ever Undisputed Champion by also beating The Rock on the same night, so this was huge for him. 
 Imagine being Jericho. Getting to play GTA III at home whilst watching your wrestling dreams come true. He probably didn't have time to take quests from Salvatore Leone, but still.
